title: rs_falsifier_result_response
description: Structured output for the readiness-score falsifier (red team). Use this to submit the single most damaging gating defect and the cheapest experiment that settles it.

defect_class.description: The class of the most damaging gating defect. Use 'none' only if you genuinely found no gating-class defect; do not invent one. 'none' is the single signal for a clean result: the fields below key off it.

defect.description: One sentence: the single most damaging defect. Empty string when defect_class is 'none'.

falsification.description: The cheapest experiment (minutes, not hours) that settles the defect. Empty string when defect_class is 'none'.

confidence.description: 0-100 confidence that the defect is real. Reported in the verdict summary and revised by cross-examination; it is not averaged into the aggregate readiness score. Must be 0 when defect_class is 'none'.

pros.description: At least 3 items: what survived the attack (nearest misses when no gating defect). Each <=140 chars.

cons.description: Defects/weaknesses, most damaging first. Each <=140 chars. These feed the verdict's required-amendments list, so list only genuine items and never pad the array to reach a count.
